task: Add a string property "RefactorNote" with the value "checked" to every PartDesign Body.
check: all(getattr(o,'RefactorNote',None)=='checked' for o in doc.Objects if o.TypeId=='PartDesign::Body')

task: Give every Sketcher sketch a Label that starts with "Sk_".
check: any(o.TypeId=='Sketcher::SketchObject' for o in doc.Objects) and all(o.Label.startswith('Sk_') for o in doc.Objects if o.TypeId=='Sketcher::SketchObject')

task: Give every PartDesign and Sketcher object a unique Label of the form <T>_<n>, where <T> is the part of its TypeId after "::" (for example "Pad_1", "SketchObject_1") and n counts from 1 per type in document order; Names must not change.
check: len({o.Label for o in doc.Objects}) == len(doc.Objects) and all(o.Label.startswith(o.TypeId.split('::')[-1] + '_') for o in doc.Objects if o.TypeId.startswith(('PartDesign::', 'Sketcher::')))

task: Move the Length of every PartDesign::Pad into an App::VarSet named "Dims" (one property per pad) and bind each pad's Length to it with an expression.
check: doc.getObject('Dims') is not None and doc.getObject('Dims').TypeId=='App::VarSet' and all(any(p=='Length' for p,e in o.ExpressionEngine) for o in doc.Objects if o.TypeId=='PartDesign::Pad')

task: Move the Length of every PartDesign::Pad into a Spreadsheet named "Dims" (one aliased cell per pad) and bind each pad's Length to it with an expression.
check: doc.getObject('Dims') is not None and doc.getObject('Dims').TypeId=='Spreadsheet::Sheet' and all(any(p=='Length' for p,e in o.ExpressionEngine) for o in doc.Objects if o.TypeId=='PartDesign::Pad')

task: Lift every literal dimension that can safely be bound (feature lengths, angles, named sketch constraints) into one App::VarSet named "Parameters", so that each of those properties is driven by an expression that reads its value from the VarSet.
check: doc.getObject('Parameters') is not None and doc.getObject('Parameters').TypeId=='App::VarSet' and ref['lift_varset'] > 0 and sum(1 for o in doc.Objects for _p, e in o.ExpressionEngine if 'Parameters.' in e) >= ref['lift_varset']

task: Lift every literal dimension that can safely be bound into one Spreadsheet named "Parameters", so that each of those properties is driven by an expression that reads its value from a cell alias.
check: doc.getObject('Parameters') is not None and doc.getObject('Parameters').TypeId=='Spreadsheet::Sheet' and ref['lift_sheet'] > 0 and sum(1 for o in doc.Objects for _p, e in o.ExpressionEngine if 'Parameters.' in e) >= ref['lift_sheet']

task: In every PartDesign Body, replace the literal dimensions of its features by expressions that read them from a Spreadsheet or VarSet (a container shared by the bodies is fine). No body may be left unparameterised.
check: len(ref['bodies']) > 0 and all(sum(1 for f in b.Group for _p, e in f.ExpressionEngine if any(c.Name in e for c in doc.Objects if c.TypeId in ('Spreadsheet::Sheet','App::VarSet'))) >= max(1, ref['bodies'].get(b.Name, 0)) for b in doc.Objects if b.TypeId == 'PartDesign::Body')

task: Set the Label of every PartDesign Body to "Body_<Name>" (its immutable Name after an underscore).
check: all(o.Label=='Body_'+o.Name for o in doc.Objects if o.TypeId=='PartDesign::Body')

task: Relabel every PartDesign::Pad as "Pad_1", "Pad_2", ... in document order (the order of doc.Objects).
check: [o.Label for o in doc.Objects if o.TypeId=='PartDesign::Pad'] == ['Pad_%d' % (i + 1) for i in range(len([o for o in doc.Objects if o.TypeId=='PartDesign::Pad']))]
